messages.author: f43fba662c7d671c
messages.subject: Aroma for ~4000 microarrays
parts:
Hello,

I'm looking to process 4000 HG-U133_Plus_2 microarrays using aroma, as it is memory-bounded.

Background correction and quantile normalization proceed reasonably quickly; however, the summarization step is very slow (estimated time of completion is several months).

Is this to be expected?

If so, are there any alternate recommendations for *only* summarizing the data?

-Ryan

messages.author: 185f4d4fdb048fb8
messages.subject: Re: [aroma.affymetrix] Aroma for ~4000 microarrays
parts:
Hi,

see http://aroma-project.org/howtos/ImproveProcessingTime

Most importantly, increasing the RAM option will make a big difference.

/Henrik
